commands.command:
cat > /root/ansible-zram/zram-swap.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Configure compressed in-memory (zram) swap on node1
  hosts: target
  become: true

  tasks:
    - name: Install zram-generator
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: zram-generator
        state: present

    - name: Configure zram device (>=512MB, zstd compression, preferred over disk swap)
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf
        content: |
          [zram0]
          zram-size = max(ram / 2, 512)
          compression-algorithm = zstd
          swap-priority = 100
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      register: zram_conf

    - name: Reload systemd manager configuration
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: zram_conf.changed

    - name: Re-run systemd generators to pick up new zram unit
      ansible.builtin.command: systemctl daemon-reload
      changed_when: false

    - name: Ensure zram swap is started now
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Verify zram swap is active
      ansible.builtin.command: swapon --show
      register: swapon_out
      changed_when: false

    - name: Show swap status
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: swapon_out.stdout_lines
EOF
echo written
commands.stdout: written
